ev.q: nine (8.3%) of the workers who received testing for influenza A(H5) received a positive result.
Reported symptoms among workers conducting depopulation who received screening by Colorado Department of Public Health & Environment, by influenza A(H5) test result and poultry facility
At facility A, 65 (25%) of 265 workers who received screening reported symptoms and received testing
Symptom onset occurred a median of 1 day after initial occupational exposure (range = 1–8 days)
by influenza A(H5) test result and poultry facility
Facility A identified no additional symptomatic workers after July 16.
This poultry exposure–associated cluster of human cases of influenza A(H5) is the first reported in the United States.

methods_quotes.q: Date of initial exposure was defined as the date when depopulation or disposal of sick poultry began
Samples were tested for influenza A(H5) via reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction on the CDC Influenza A/H5 Subtyping Diagnostic assay.
Specimens testing presumptively positive for influenza A(H5) virus or with inconclusive results were sent to CDC for confirmatory testing.
